The bundle itself has two sub-components. The GPU one is `ai-platform.gpu-nodes`. Let me fetch that component and the agnosticv file in parallel.Here are the figures for the `ai-platform.gpu-nodes` component on the `kite` cluster:

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| **GPU instance type** | `g6e.12xlarge` |
| **Instances per order** | **4** |
| **Cloud provider** | AWS (`ec2`) |
| **NVIDIA driver channel** | `v580` |
| **Defining agnosticv file** | [`ai-platform/gpu-nodes/common.yaml`](https://github.com/rhpds/agnosticv/blob/main/ai-platform/gpu-nodes/common.yaml) |

**For your quota increase request:**
- Each "AI Platform Bundle" order provisions **4 × `g6e.12xlarge`** GPU nodes via the `accelerators` sub-component (`ai-platform.gpu-nodes`).
- The relevant variables driving this are `gpu_machineset_instance_type: g6e.12xlarge` and `gpu_machineset_replicas: 4`, both set in that common.yaml.
- Multiply 4 by your expected concurrent order count to size the quota ask (e.g., 10 concurrent orders → 40 `g6e.12xlarge` instances).

---

**Sources:** Babylon cluster `kite` (`get_component` for `ai-platform-bundle` and `ai-platform.gpu-nodes`), [agnosticv `ai-platform/gpu-nodes/common.yaml`](https://github.com/rhpds/agnosticv/blob/main/ai-platform/gpu-nodes/common.yaml)
